chat.blackannin_drone.already_has_drone: You already have a drone deployed!
blackannin_drone.configuration.title: BlackAnnin's Drone
blackannin_drone.configuration.droneFoll: Horizontal follow distance behind the player
blackannin_drone.configuration.droneTake: Ticks to wait after placement (20 ticks = 1 second)
blackannin_drone.configuration.droneMaxR: Maximum horizontal distance from the owner in manual mode
blackannin_drone.configuration.spoutEnab: Drone FPV first-person camera; feed is sent to OBS via Spout2, resolution follows the game window
blackannin_drone.configuration.spoutSend: Name shown in the OBS Spout source list
blackannin_drone.configuration.spoutWidt: Width of the frame sent to OBS, applied on the next frame
blackannin_drone.configuration.spoutHeig: Height of the frame sent to OBS, applied on the next frame
blackannin_drone.configuration.spoutLibr: Leave empty to search natives/SpoutLibrary.dll in the game directory
blackannin_drone.configuration.droneSpee: Drone speeds up with player movement (0 = unaffected)
blackannin_drone.configuration.droneTele: Teleport back to the player beyond this distance (blocks)
FOV of the drone view, independent of the player setting (70 = default)
blackannin_drone.configuration.spoutDebu: Write the actual frame sent to OBS as drone_stream_debug.png in the game directory
